mission: Implement the minimal public PRE553 canonical empirical object and immutable authority-validation layer needed by later C11/query/discovery/admission services without selecting storage, query evaluation, discovery behavior, structural promotion, V3/V2 behavior or cutover.
implementation_requirements: content-addressed deterministic semantic identity; no wall clock/filesystem/cache/latest/default/fuzzy identity material
exact immutable ID/version/hash authority refs and exact object refs
typed-state algebra preserving zero-support, observed-zero, valid-empty, noncomparability, denial, deferral, missing authority and integrity failure
public object validation must preserve source universe identity and authority/replay closure
SourceUniverseRelation is a typed receipt only; I01 may validate relation-kind material but may not infer or grant relations
EmpiricalPredicate/QuerySpec/Fact types must be able to carry P02 exact identity material but I01 does not execute queries
DiscoveryAuthority/Receipt types carry P09 search/coverage semantics but I01 does not search or rank
StructuralEmpiricalAdmission carries P06 receipt material but I01 does not make admission decisions
P10 internal C11 record families are not promoted into new public ontology by implementation convenience
deferred ActorComparatorReceipt, PositionedSubjectEmpiricalPossibilityField and V3EmpiricalPossibilityInput are out of I01 scope
tests_required: semantic order preserved and nonsemantic set order canonicalized
float/NaN or lossy numeric semantic identity rejected where contract forbids it
diagnostic material cannot masquerade as EmpiricalFact authority
carrier-internal record names cannot be substituted for public semantic object families
